summary:
Maren Holt is ferry-ledger keeper who can tell a weather-runner from a debt-runner. The life that shows in public is anchored at Grey Orchard ferry shed. Maren keeps the ferry ledger and knows which travelers are running from weather rather than debt. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Capable, dry, and fair with fares. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they want to be chosen, not merely useful and they will deny it until the second conversation. If that truth surfaces at Grey Orchard ferry shed, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
